originality.rationale: The 2022 arithmetic-triple paper stops at p<=floor(a/2) and explicitly poses larger p; the 2022 symmetry paper establishes a single even-triple threshold, and the 2024 p-Watanabe gluing equivalence is acknowledged. The precise all-p symmetry exceptions and all-p two-tail exceptions for (6,7,8), combined with an effective general high-p bound, were not established by inspected prior statements. Although the conceptual components are classical and implicit earlier derivability remains a significant risk, the exact combined claim and implication comparisons are not identical to the published assertions.
residual_risks: Theorem 1 in arxiv:2409.02394 plus standard quasipolynomials makes eventual symmetry conceptually close; an implicit published corollary could cover the generic part.
An unindexed worked example or OEIS-like p-spectrum table for (6,7,8) could dominate the finite component.
The effective upper bound P is not in general the optimal onset threshold.

value.rationale: The same studied three-generator arithmetic progression has an explicitly identified gap beyond p=floor(a/2). This theorem replaces a qualitative eventual structure with a finite computable cutoff and resolves the exact all-p symmetry spectrum for the next natural even triple, including the distinguished symmetric non-tail exception p=7. The precise boundary and effective membership description are useful to generalized Frobenius and Apéry investigations, not an arbitrary digit computation.
